detail.longDescription: I have a confirmit survey where i have BG fields S_state_fips, S_state , respemail variables. My survey page gets email and State (dropdown field) from the respondent and i want to validate the combination on respondentdata: Survey page: on the custom validation, I am trying to verify email and state combo as below: if (f(CurrentForm()).toBoolean()) { // Values entered by respondent var enteredEmail = String(f("verify_email")).Trim().ToLower(); var selectedState = String(f("verify_state")).Trim(); // Pull background values using the native GetRespondent method var storedEmail = String(GetRespondent("respemail")).Trim().ToLower(); var storedState = String(GetRespondent("S_state_fips")).Trim(); // Normalize numeric state codes: 01 and 1 should match var stateMatches = Number(selectedState) == Number(storedState); if (enteredEmail != storedEmail || !stateMatches) { RaiseError(); SetErrorMessage( 9, "The email address and state do not match our records. Please verify your information." ); } } I get an error for this as: Error in QuestionValidationCode : Variable 'GetRespondent' has not been declared I also tried: var storedEmail = String(f("respemail").Value).Trim().ToLower(); var storedState = String(f("S_state_fips").Value).Trim(); StoredEmail and storedState comes as "Undefined". Can someone please guide on how to fix this?
